entities.summary: The Catholic Church of the Holy Family is a neogothic brick church in Kaliningrad. It was built in the Haberberg city district of Königsberg, near the Pregel river, between 1904 and 1907. Church of the Holy Family is a church building in Europe, established in 1904.
